company.description:
Intego develops and sells desktop Internet security and privacy software for Macs. It provides a range of software to protect users and their Macs from the dangers of the Internet. Its multilingual software and support repeatedly receives awards from Mac magazines, and protects more than one million users in over 60 countries.

Intego was established in 1997 with headquarters in the USA, France, and Japan.
